# E0218: a minor version adds or tightens a validator

A validator such as strings.MinRunes rejects values that fail it. A minor
version that adds one, or tightens one, rejects values the predecessor
accepted.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
import "strings"

name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				s: string
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				s: strings.MinRunes(1)
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0218]: s in schema 0.1 must now satisfy strings.MinRunes(1), which the prior schema did not require
  --> lineage.cue:13:5
   |
13 |                 s: strings.MinRunes(1)
   |                 ^
   |
   = note: schema 0.1 is declared as a minor version of 0.0, so every instance of schema 0.0 must be an instance of it (compatibility rule validator-added)
   = help: make the change compatible, or make this version 1.0
```
